dataset_name: NotebookLM Lite — AI Engineering PDF RAG Evaluation
source_scope: Closed-book evaluation against uploaded sources only

schema_notes.reference_answers: Not included; add human-verified gold answers before scoring semantic answer accuracy.
schema_notes.citations: Answerable cases require exact document and page citations.
schema_notes.abstention: Unanswerable cases require an explicit abstention and no fabricated citations.
schema_notes.multi_document: Requires at least two relevant documents; with one PDF, mark BLOCKED rather than PASS.
schema_notes.page_numbers: Hints are printed book pages, not PDF viewer indexes; resolve the mapping during ingestion.
schema_notes.external_search: Disable web/external retrieval for this closed-book benchmark.
